name: drape-background
title: Drape Background
description: A full-bleed simulated fabric backdrop in charcoal tones, hanging in soft vertical pleats with white copy centred over it. It sways in a slow breeze and can be pushed, grabbed and pulled aside.
use: An atmospheric full-bleed backdrop for fashion, launch or editorial pages where copy sits over texture.
avoid: It is built for dark themes, and the full-screen fabric simulation keeps the CPU busy while it moves.
a11y: The canvas is hidden from assistive tech; reduced motion removes the breeze and the push and grab handlers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: The frame is filled by dark cloth in even vertical pleats, its crests catching faint grey light while valleys fall to black. Centred over it are a white headline, a tiny spaced-out eyebrow and one line of grey copy.
behaves: The curtain hangs and sways under a slow breeze, its lower folds drifting in long curves and settling again. Moving the pointer presses the fabric and drags it along; pressing grabs the nearest fold so it can be pulled aside.
customise: Pass any content as children to layer over the cloth, or null for a bare backdrop. Wind strength, pleat depth and pointer interaction are props; the cloth colours follow the page theme.
weight: heavy: A CPU cloth simulation relaxes thousands of links every frame before each WebGL draw.
